full_judgment: 33. Furthermore, from the letter dated 7-3-2017 bearing Memo No. প্রশাঃ ইবি/২০১৭/১২৮৯, it appears that the Acting Registrar of the University wrote to the Officer-in-Charge, Islamic University Thana, Kushtia regarding Filing of a FIR about the incident in question. On a perusal of the same, it appears that the persons named in the FIR are the teachers and staff of the University, including one Post-Graduate student pursuing a Master Decree in the Department of Mathematic. Apart from the aforesaid persons, not a single student from amongst the 100 students, who took part and qualified in the admission test of F Unit held on 7-12-2016, has been named in the FIR.
